description: A ginger farm cat lies stretched full length along the flat roof of the nearest hive, tail hanging over the edge and one ear flicking at the hum below.
A speckled hen scratches and dust-bathes in the bare patch of earth in front of the hive stands, feathers fluffed out and one wing spread flat.
A shaggy farm dog lies flat on its side in the cool grass at the end of the hive row, chin on the ground and eyes half shut.
A pair of ducks files past the hive stands one behind the other, heads low and bills working through the grass as they go.
A nanny goat leans her whole head over the low fence beside the apiary, ears forward and jaw working on a mouthful of hedge.
A blackbird stands on the crown of a hive lid with its head turned side-on and its feathers smooth, quite unbothered by the traffic below.
Three brown hens pick along the base of the hive stands in a loose line, bobbing and pausing as they work through the grass.
A young tabby sits bolt upright on an upended super beside the hives, front paws neat together and both ears swivelled toward the hum.
A woolly sheep grazes on the far side of the fence, cropping steadily along the line of the wire with its fleece in tight curls.
A grey rabbit sits low in the long grass at the edge of the apiary, ears laid flat along its back and nose working.
A ginger cat is curled asleep inside an empty super at the end of the bench, nose tucked under one paw and the box exactly her size.
A farm dog lies stretched across the honey room's floorboards just inside the door, head down flat and both front paws twitching.
A tabby sits on the bench beside the jars with its tail curled round its own feet, ears turning at every small sound.
A speckled hen stands in the open doorway of the honey room looking in, one foot raised, her feathers bright against the timber.
